name: Spectre makes Withering Touch always apply Ghost Claw (#2038)
contract: Spectre 561170 Effect1 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (ProcChance 100) on EffectTriggerSpell 803985
(Ghost Claw), restricted by AscensionReaperTalentProcs.h to only fire off spell 573071 (Withering Touch).
Spell.dbc ProcFlags for 561170 is 0, so before a spell_proc row existed the proc never registered at all.
rev_20260921_20 adds a spell_proc row for 561170 but with SpellPhaseMask 1 (cast phase only); at cast
phase the native proc call in Spell::cast() passes a null action target (Unit::ProcSkillsAndAuras(...,
nullptr, ..., PROC_SPELL_PHASE_CAST)), so AuraEffect::HandleProcTriggerSpellAuraProc casts Ghost Claw at a
null target and fails (SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS). An ordinary Withering Touch cast with Spectre known must
apply Ghost Claw (803985, the slow aura 33 at EffectBasePoints -41) to the touched target.

steps.label: Spectre's proc makes Withering Touch also apply Ghost Claw to the same target
